speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility; to begin our evaluation, have you experienced frequent fractures or bone breaks from minor injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) - Salt-Wasting or Non-Salt-Wasting form presenting with virilization (clitoromegaly, hirsutism, acne), delayed puberty, and potential bone density issues due to hormonal imbalances.

REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone, ACTH stimulation test, electrolytes (Na, K), and bone mineral density scan.
